body.script: (()=>{const here=new URL(location.href),parts=here.pathname.split("/"),gh=parts.indexOf("gh");const owner=gh>=0?parts[gh+1]:"",segment=gh>=0?parts[gh+2]:"";const at=segment.indexOf("@"),repo=at>0?segment.slice(0,at):"",ref=at>0?segment.slice(at+1):"";const dir=here.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/,""),open=document.getElementById("open");const atRef=function(next){const url=new URL(here.href);url.pathname=repo?("/gh/"+owner+"/"+repo+"@"+next+"/index.svg"):dir+"index.svg";url.search="";return url};const go=function(href){open.href=href;location.replace(href)};const stale=function(){const url=atRef(ref);url.searchParams.set("v",Date.now().toString(36));go(url.href)};const ask=function(worker){return new Promise(function(done){if(!worker||!window.MessageChannel)return done(false);const channel=new MessageChannel(),timer=setTimeout(function(){done(false)},1500);channel.port1.onmessage=function(event){clearTimeout(timer);done(!!(event.data&&event.data.build))};try{worker.postMessage({drift:"shell?"},[channel.port2])}catch(error){clearTimeout(timer);done(false)}})};const handover=function(sha){const pinned=atRef(sha).href,url=atRef(ref);url.searchParams.set("build",sha);if(!navigator.serviceWorker)return go(pinned);navigator.serviceWorker.register(dir+"sw.js?entry=latest",{scope:dir}).then(function(registration){const worker=registration.active||registration.installing||registration.waiting;if(!worker||worker.state==="activated")return registration;return new Promise(function(done){const check=function(){if(worker.state==="activated"||worker.state==="redundant")done()};worker.addEventListener("statechange",check);check()}).then(function(){return registration})}).then(function(registration){return ask(registration.active)}).then(function(aware){go(aware?url.href:pinned)}).catch(function(){go(pinned)})};if(!repo||/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(ref)){go(atRef(ref||"main").href);return}const api="https://api.github.com/repos/"+owner+"/"+repo,options={cache:"no-store",headers:{accept:"application/vnd.github+json"}};const read=function(path){return fetch(api+path,options).then(function(response){if(response.status===404)return null;if(!response.ok)throw new Error(String(response.status));return response.json()})};const commitOf=function(data){return data&&data.object&&data.object.type==="commit"&&/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(data.object.sha)?data.object.sha:null};read("/git/ref/heads/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(function(data){return commitOf(data)||read("/git/ref/tags/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(commitOf)}).then(function(sha){return sha||read("/commits/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(function(data){return data&&/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(data.sha)?data.sha:null})}).then(function(sha){sha?handover(sha):stale()}).catch(stale)})();
